title: On the Stability of Power Systems with AI Data Centers: A Multi-Equilibrium Switched DAE Framework
summary: The rapid growth of Artificial Intelligence (AI) data centers is introducing dynamic loads into power transmission systems as GPU clusters switch between computational phases with distinct power demands. These dynamics are naturally modeled by switched affine differential-algebraic equations (DAEs), where each mode induces a different equilibrium and consistency space. We study their stability using control and hybrid systems tools.
